pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. A — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Toileting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
